## Checklist

- [ ] I made this item, or I have the right to publish it under the licence in its `item.json`.
- [ ] The licence's SPDX id is correct, and `attribution` says exactly what users must credit (when the licence asks for credit).
- [ ] The archive is attached to a GitHub Release in my repository, and its version file was written by `just store pack`.
- [ ] I installed it into a fresh project from my Release with `just store install <id> --source <my local catalog>` and it worked.
- [ ] Code items only: the source repository is public and linked as `sourceRepo`, and it says which native plugins it brings in (the store refuses build hooks and platform folders itself; this catalog's maintainers review plugins).
